title: AGA General Modpack
description: This modpack is related to optimization and single-player features.
body:
This modpack is related to optimization and single-player features.

The modpack includes optimization mods, a mod that allows you to play single-player worlds with your friends and a mod that lets you look around with a free camera. It also includes a schematic mode and mods that show slime chunks, spawn chunks, areas where mobs can spawn etc.
